channel.title: The Tanzania Times - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Tanzania Times (tanzaniatimes.net)

item.title: Beijing and Washington relations were in spotlight during at the China Development Forum 2026
item.description: Delegates expressed the willingness to further explore the Chinese market, play an active role, and continuously deepen the economic and trade cooperation between the two countries.

item.title: Banks in East Africa are turning to digital platforms and Artificial Intelligence
item.description: With increasing adoption of mobile banking, agency networks, and embedded finance, banks are redesigning services to match evolving customer expectations across urban and rural markets.

item.title: Coca-Cola creates 87,000 jobs in South Africa and pumps USD 3 Billion into the country’s economy
item.description: This investment highlights the system’s commitment to investing, producing, and distributing locally, while contributing to South Africa’s social and economic development.

item.title: Arumeru Youth League enters second round with still several weeks to go before the May 2026 climax
item.description: However, the Arumeru Youth league still has some weeks to go before its third season climaxes on the first week of May 2026, which means things are subjected to change in the near future, without notice.

item.title: Heavy rains coupled with warm temperatures to feature throughout April 2026
item.description: Wetter than normal conditions expected over most parts of the region including Ethiopia, Djibouti, northern Eritrea, Kenya, central to southern Somalia, central to southern South Sudan, Uganda, Rwanda, Burundi and Tanzania.

item.title: Don’t Let History Repeat Itself in the 21st Century
item.description: Not in abstract figures, but in lived reality: homes in ruins, mass graves, and families driven from everything they knew. The images are horrendous and shocking to watch.

item.title: The Man Who Became Myth: How Chuck Norris Shaped a Generation Beyond the Screen!
item.description: To write about Norris is not to chronicle an actor’s career; it is to interrogate the anatomy of influence itself, how a man forged in modest beginnings became a global emblem of resilience, justice, and cultural mythology.

item.title: Tuberculosis causes 85,000 deaths from 920,000 new cases in the Eastern Mediterranean Region
item.description: Between 2020 to 2024, over 2.8 million TB cases were diagnosed and successfully treated – treatment success rates exceeded 90 percent– contributing to a significant reduction in the TB burden

item.title: Libya’s Ministry of Defense secures the Russian Ghost Ship, Artic Metagaz, onto a tugboat before disaster
item.description: A team from the Libyan Ministry of Defense successfully boarded the damaged Russian LNG tanker Arctic Metagaz and managed to secure it to a tugboat dispatched from the port of Misrata.

item.title: Elon Musk thrown out of Namibia, attempting to offer the country Internet Services through his Starlink
item.description: Elon Musk’s attempts to start providing direct to satellite internet services in Namibia have been thwarted by local authorities.Reports from Windhoek reveal that the Communications Regulatory Authority of Namibia (CRAN) has declined the application
